newsitem.title: USA: Tampa, Fla., airport sees 14 pct gain in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Tampa, Fla., airport sees 14 pct gain in 1996.

text.p: Passenger traffic at Florida's Tampa International Airport reached a record 13 million for 1996, an increase of 1.6 million passengers or 14 percent over last year, the Hillsborough County Aviation Authority said.

Airport officials said much of the increase was due to the addition of flights by Dallas-based Southwest Airlines Co which grew from 12 daily flights in January to 25 by December. The discount carrier spurred competition, boosting traffic on other airlines.
Southwest is the fourth largest carrier at the airport, behind USAir Group Inc, Delta Air Lines Inc and Northwest Airlines Corp.
